Its route opens the first gate, collects the refill, crosses the passage while small, grows on the upper platform, opens the second gate, teleports while large, and approaches the exit.

   That two-unit shortfall is **conditional on the model**. I checked the main route segments and costs through play, but have not fully modeled growth placement or verified the exact exit trigger. Therefore, the search does not prove impossibility in the actual game. A complete account of those rules, followed by a route search, would settle it—or a demonstrated cheaper route would establish that it is winnable.

After shrinking, teleporting repeatedly reached the white pad instead. Growing restored the blue destination markings, although I did not verify the subsequent teleport in that restored form.

Inside the narrow passage, it failed at both tested positions. Those observations establish limited adjustment, but not its search order, distance limit, or precise containment requirements. I also have not verified exactly when approaching the exit counts as completion.

CONFIDENCE: 90
